Mira: Quick sync: APAC marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need SKU mapping, region tags (ap-southeast-1), and legal telemetry blurb.
Jonah: Sales asks whether GPU should be a separate SKU or tiering.
Mira: Prefer two SKUs: REDWOOD-MKT-STD and REDWOOD-MKT-GPU. Sales Ops to confirm.
Elena: GCP image not tagged for asia-southeast1 yet. I can retag and push if manifest entry is finalized.
Kevin: I'll add checksums (sha256) for each artifact and include sizes.
SI-Team: We need the terraform module path and an example with variables: sku, region, license_key. Provide module v0.2.
Legal: Telemetry must list collected metrics + storage region. Trial length: 14 days for Azure private offers.
Mira: Tasks: Jonah -> finalize SKU with Sales Ops; Elena -> retag GCP image & update manifest; Kevin -> checksums.txt; SI-Team -> prepare terraform example; Legal -> review telemetry copy.
marketplace-bot: Staging checklist updated: manifest=awaiting, checksums=awaiting, eula=i18n pending, sku=awaiting-sales.
Jonah: I'll ping Sales Ops, aim to confirm SKU by 4pm.
Elena: Retagging now, will push manifest to staging once SKU list is in. Link will be posted.
Kevin: Uploaded checksums after Elena pushes. CI will validate.
Mira: If SKU + telemetry approved today, target staging publish tomorrow AM. Post blockers here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
